answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for shadow work and spiritual practice, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s “Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work”**, **Awake Academy’s “Embracing The Shadow” with Charlie Morley**, and **ManTalks’ “Shadow Course”** for a more guided, structured approach.[3][10][18]

A practical way to choose is:

- **Most academically grounded shadow work:** **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** on Jung Platform, which is explicitly framed around Jungian psychology.[3]
- **Best for a spiritual-leaning approach:** **Embracing The Shadow** with Charlie Morley on Awake Academy.[10]
- **Best for step-by-step self-study:** **ManTalks Shadow Course** and the **7-Day Shadow Work Online Course** described on Peter Paul Parker’s site.[18][7]
- **Best low-cost/broad marketplace option:** Udemy’s **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** and related shadow work courses, which are accessible but vary in depth and instructor quality.[2][14][16][17]
- **Best for certification-style study:** **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** and **Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course**.[4][5]

If you also want **spiritual practice** beyond shadow work, the results point more toward courses that combine reflection, meditation, and inner work, especially **Awake Academy** and **Insight Timer’s “Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing And Growth”**.[10][12]

A simple shortlist by goal:

| Goal | Best pick |
|---|---|
| Jungian depth | **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work**[3] |
| Spiritual integration | **Embracing The Shadow**[10] |
| Structured self-paced learning | **Shadow Course** / **7-Day Shadow Work Online Course**[18][7] |
| Budget-friendly option | **Udemy shadow work courses**[2][14][16][17] |
| Certificate focus | **Shadow Mastery Course** / **Shadow Work Practitioner**[4][5] |

If you want, I can narrow these down to the **top 3 best courses** based on your budget, whether you want **psychology vs. spirituality**, and how much structure you want.
